evaluation.derivative_diagnostic: band_errors from the existing shared numerical helper; denominator floors use the original 100 training initial fields only

primary_comparison.estimand: paired per-trajectory relative-L2 difference, interval minus pointwise, averaged over the three frozen model seeds
primary_comparison.adjustment: Bonferroni across the two condition-specific primary contrasts
primary_comparison.interpretation: no equivalence margin or success threshold; no formal equivalence claim

secondary_comparisons: Report all four arms and all seeds; contrasts against none and full curvature are descriptive.
evidence_boundary: The confirmation trajectories are from the declared existing initial-condition distribution but have new independent IDs and are never used for model development. QA cases are disjoint. The confirmation set is consumed once evaluation begins.
